events.name: World Chess Championship — Opening Ceremony
events.notes: Opening ceremony and media day. Start time has not been confirmed. Gukesh D (World Champion) vs Javokhir Sindarov (Challenger). Schedule: https://worldchampionship.fide.com/

events.name: World Chess Championship — Game 1
events.venue: Fondation Martin Bodmer, Route Martin-Bodmer 19, 1223 Cologny
events.notes:
FIDE World Chess Championship 2026 — Game 1 of up to 14.
Gukesh D (defending champion) vs Javokhir Sindarov (challenger).
Start: 9:00 AM US Eastern / 3:00 PM Geneva (CET).
This short calendar entry marks the start only; classical games last much longer.
The match ends when one player reaches 7.5 points; later games may not take place.
Official schedule: https://worldchampionship.fide.com/
